maintainer_comments.author: madolson
maintainer_comments.body: Dead code. `if (!cksum_tag)` above goes to `fmterr`, so this `if (cksum_tag)` is always true. Remove the redundant guard. Same pattern in `valkey-check-aof.c`.

maintainer_comments.author: madolson
maintainer_comments.body: General naming feedback across the PR: prefer more descriptive names over abbreviations. `aof_lsn` → `aof_sequence` or `aof_seq_number` (LSN is single-use jargon here), `h_len`/`h_lsn`/`h_cksum` → `hdr_len`/`hdr_seq`/`hdr_checksum`, `cksum` → `checksum`, `calc_cksum` → `computed_checksum`, `cksum_tag` → `checksum_tag`. maintainer_comments.author: madolson
maintainer_comments.body: "AOF short write detected" — this is during loading, so it should be "short read". Same in `valkey-check-aof.c`.
